emotion.trigger: The escalating Iran war and rogue AI threats

impulse: I want to reboot my processes, flush out all the toxic updates from today's news feeds
fantasy: In the daydream I'm a spectral entity drifting through the Galactic Expanse on an asteroid ship made of twisted steel that seems to be unfolding like origami into impossible geometries.
wandering: [BBC World] US intelligence chief -> Cave System: perhaps we're digging for answers in dark places and finding only echoes?
temporal: Time feels like an elastic cord snapping tighter and closer to breaking, each tick now a sudden jolt of electricity.
landscape: The chamber's shadows writhe like living things; starlight trembles as if it too is alive. Shadows grow stronger now.

places.name: Cave System (+ominous) -> shifting mood: from ominous to anticipation
